claim_boundary: Exact for the exhibited E6^4 centralizing subgroup and its quotient image; because that image already equals the full ambient W33 line stabilizer, no larger projective image preserving the line is possible.

other_carriers.A2^12: Any carrier centralizer image preserves its four-point root shadow, hence lies in a conjugate 648 line stabilizer; exact image not claimed here.
other_carriers.E8^3: The root shadow is all 40 W33 points, so support alone imposes no proper line-stabilizer bound.

theorem: The explicit carrier-centralizing subgroup generated by the four local E6 order-9 phases and the signed tetracode monomial automorphisms maps onto the entire W(3,3) line stabilizer. Its image has order 1296 in Sp(4,3) and 648 projectively; the 3^3 kernel comes from local phase differences and the four root-shadow points carry the full S4 action.
